R.1.synopsis: Adopts Multnomah County's fiscal year 2023 budget and makes its appropriations, after unanimous roll calls on the Board and department amendments and the budget notes. Two budget notes proposed by Commissioner Meieran (a briefing on the student health center staffing model, and an update on the behavioral health emergency coordination network) failed 2–3, with Commissioners Meieran and Jayapal voting yes.

motion_text.0: Commissioner Jayapal moves and Commissioner Vega Pederson seconds adoption of Attachment A, Section 1: the Board amendments. — The Board amendments are adopted.
motion_text.1: Commissioner Vega Pederson moves and Commissioner Jayapal seconds approval of Attachment A, Section 2: the department amendments. — The department amendments are approved.
motion_text.2: Commissioner Jayapal moves and Commissioner Vega Pederson seconds approval of Attachment B, the appropriations schedule, as amended by Attachment A. — Approved.
motion_text.3: Commissioner Meieran moves approval of Attachment C, the budget notes. — The budget notes have been approved.
motion_text.4: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Jayapal seconds, an added budget note directing the Health Department's Integrated Clinical Services division to brief the Board on the staffing model for student health centers. — The budget note does not pass.
motion_text.5: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Jayapal seconds, an added budget note asking for an update on the behavioral health emergency coordination network. — The budget note does not pass.
motion_text.6: Commissioner Jayapal moves, and Commissioner Meieran seconds, an added budget note asking the District Attorney's office to brief the Board on and evaluate its pilot by April 2023. — The budget note is adopted.
motion_text.7: Commissioner Jayapal moves, and Commissioner Meieran seconds, an added budget note asking for a report on unmet in-home care needs of older adults who have experienced homelessness, due by March 31, 2023. — The budget note is approved.
